title: BusinessProcess
description: Reference schema for a Business Process node. Source files are YAML; this schema validates the parsed structure for a single BP1 file (a tree rooted at one BP1 process category). Business processes describe HOW work is done, anchored on APQC PCF's Category → Process Group → Process → Activity hierarchy. They are an artefact orthogonal to capabilities (BC) and value streams (VS); cross-references go via `realizes_capability_ids` and via VS-stage `process_ids`.

id.description: Stable identifier. BP-<L1>[.<L2>[.<L3>[.<L4>]]] mirroring the capability id scheme. Max depth 4. Sparse 10/20/30 numbering at every level.

name.description: Display name. Two-tier rule: (a) BP1 roots aligned to a value stream use the source VS bookend name verbatim ('Order-to-Cash', 'Hire-to-Retire', 'Procure-to-Pay'); BP1 roots not derived from a VS use a Title-Case noun phrase. (b) BP2/BP3/BP4 names are verb-phrased operational activities ('Capture Customer Order', 'Verify Customer Credit', 'Allocate Inventory to Order'). Aliases are disabled by governance — every node has exactly one canonical name.

level.description: Decomposition depth. Must equal depth in the tree (root=1). 1=Category, 2=Process Group, 3=Process, 4=Activity.

industry.description: Industry classification. 'Cross-Industry', a single industry, or semicolon-separated list. Inherited from BP1 if absent. Must match the capability catalogue's L1 industry vocabulary.

references.description: Free-form URI evidence (whitepapers, vendor docs, regulator pages). For machine-readable cross-walks to APQC/BIAN/eTOM use `framework_refs`.

framework_refs.description: Structured cross-references to external process / capability frameworks. Each entry pins a framework, an external id (e.g. APQC PCF code), and an optional version.

framework.description: Source framework. APQC-PCF = APQC Process Classification Framework (cross-industry and industry-specific PCFs share this code; pin the variant via `version`). BIAN = Banking Industry Architecture Network service domains. eTOM = TM Forum enhanced Telecom Operations Map. ITIL = ITIL 4 service-management practices and Service Value Chain. SCOR = ASCM Supply Chain Operations Reference (Plan/Source/Make/Deliver/Return/Enable). DCOR = ASCM Design Chain Operations Reference (product development). COBIT = ISACA COBIT 2019 IT governance objectives. SHRM-BoCK = SHRM Body of Competency and Knowledge (HR). ISO-55000 = asset management. ISO-31000 = risk management. COSO-ERM = COSO Enterprise Risk Management 2017. TOGAF = TOGAF ADM phases / capability map. BIZBOK = Business Architecture Body of Knowledge. ACORD = ACORD insurance reference architecture. ICMM = Mining Principles / ICMM frameworks.

external_id.description: Native identifier in the source framework (e.g. APQC PCF '8.1.1.1'; BIAN service domain name; eTOM process code).

realizes_capability_ids.description: Capabilities this process realizes. Used to derive the reverse `realizes_processes` index on capability records at build time — single source of truth lives on the BP side.

metadata.description: Escape hatch for governance fields not yet promoted to first-class.
